title: Lottery & Qualification — Leadville Race Series (2027 LT100 Run entry rules and qualifiers)
claims: Deferral registration for all 2027 Leadville Race Series events runs November 1-15, 2026; the LT100 MTB and Run lottery runs December 1-15, 2026; lottery results are announced January 6, 2027; general registration opens January 7, 2027.
Lottery entry selection is free, but credit card information is collected and charged only if the athlete is accepted or makes a donation; a donation does not increase selection chances.

The team registration option was removed in 2025; all participants enter the lottery as individuals; only one application per person is allowed; athletes with an existing 2027 entry may not enter the 2027 lottery.

Selected participants are notified by the email used at registration; the card is automatically charged the registration fee plus processing fee and add-ons; a declined card gives one week to update payment or the spot is forfeited.
All registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable, subject to Leadville Race Series terms and restrictions.

Run qualifier events are the Leadville Trail Marathon, Silver Rush 50 Run and Austin Rattler Run; each offers a minimum of 35 LT100 qualifier coins; coins go only to athletes who finish the longest distance; athletes must be 18 years of age on LT100 race day.
Coin winners must be present at the awards ceremony and claim their entry immediately, then complete and pay for LT100 registration during the designated time offered.

Performance coins go to the top overall men's and women's 1st-3rd (overall winners are removed from age groups) and one coin to the top podium of each remaining category; unaccepted coins roll down within the category; remaining coins are drawn by lottery among official finishers who completed the qualifier within its official cutoff.

Guaranteed entry routes include Run Camp + Entry packages, Boundless Coaching + Entry packages, charity slots, volunteer lottery preference, and Life Time Club-Access member priority entry (member guaranteed spots open 11/24/26 at 10am MST; non-selected members are entered in the general lottery twice).
